text:
carla: Quick idea for the launch hero: a single sweep chart showing latency (ms) on X and $/1k tokens on Y, with three bands (Real-time, Near-real-time, Background). Call out product levers (batching, cache, quant) with arrows.

ben: Love it. Can we add a tiny ROI inset for 3 customer archetypes so SDRs can route leads faster? e.g., Startup Chatbot (250k tok/mo), Scale SaaS (2M tok/mo), Regulated (audit reqs).

nora: Yes, and intake form should have fields: monthly_tokens, latency_target_ms, compliance_flag. Ops: auto-tag rules to map to Hosted / Dedicated / Private.

ops-bot: @nora created tco-intake-v2: https://forms.redwood/internal/tco-intake-v2. Auto-tags: if monthly_tokens < 1e6 -> trial, if >=1e6 -> sizing, if compliance_flag true -> compliance.

carla: Messaging options: short: "Tune latency. Control cost." long: "Practical levers to move your app along the latency vs cost curve." Use short for social, long for blog.

ben: Design asks: export hero SVG 1200x600, microcase PNG 400x200, slide export 16:9. Use colorblind palette, linear axes. Deadline: Tue EOD.

nora: Sales playbook blurbs: Trial -> "Start on Hosted, enable cache". Sizing -> "Dedicated sizing + batching". Compliance -> "Private + KMS & audit docs". Add one sentence about auto-fallback to preserve availability under load.

carla: I'll draft the hero caption and microcase numbers (marked as examples). Ben, can you mock a tiny ascii for design?

ben: ascii: 
```
 $/1k tok
   ^            [green band]
   |         /-> batching
   |       /  
   |-----+-----------------> latency ms
   |     \  
   |      \-> quant
 [red band]
```

carla: perfect. I'll post the copy draft here tomorrow. Closing thread once assets uploaded. :thumbsup:
